method: One actual all-stdio C-client PTY, controlled TCP fixture, successive TIOCSWINSZ; screenshots replay each actual redraw in an owned xterm.
fixture: Deterministic layout test data, not Qwen model output.
checks: STATUS JSON stays outside chat; successive updates replace one visible metadata line
upstream completed STATUS remains finishing until the C protocol emits END
light theme renders THINK gray and formal answer black; END leaves one per-turn summary
two turns retain distinct prompts, answers and exactly one final summary each
/thinking changes only transcript presentation and restores the cached reasoning
one live PTY reflows at 140x38, 96x28, 60x18 and 40x10 while preserving its editable Unicode draft
PgUp/PgDn scroll transcript history while preserving the draft and sending no request
/theme dark is local; cached transcript and draft use the dark foreground/background palette
after all resizes and controls, Enter submits the exact original UTF-8 draft; exit restores termios
33ms UI ticks do not refresh the 1500ms network deadline; a silent peer leaves a pending checkpoint and an editable error screen
active Ctrl+Z/foreground resume beyond the idle limit drains queued HEARTBEAT, DELTA and END without a false timeout
a readable but incomplete frame retains its bounded transfer deadline and reports a frame timeout distinctly from network silence
